notes.title: v.1.4.0 is Now Coming on July 5th!
notes.notes:
[p]The next major update for [b]Angelica's Chaotic Hardcore School Remastered[/b], version [b]1.4.0[/b], will now release earlier than expected on [b]July 5th[/b]. The announcement came alongside the release of a [b]second teaser trailer[/b], giving players a brief look at what’s coming.[/p][p]One of the highlights is the introduction of a new teacher, [b]Flaggerong Flagensky[/b], whose movements closely mirror those of [b]Angelica Wilkins[/b]. The update is expected to bring more detailed story content, such as the story introduction and the intro game cutscene. And more.
More details will be revealed as launch day approaches.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="zFdL9kvBoPA;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: A Message From DyymaStudio
notes.notes:
In an unexpected announcement, we have decided to cancel [b]Free Mode[/b], which allowed players to roam freely outside the main school, will no longer be part of the game’s future updates.

This decision was made to focus entirely on the game’s lore and main horror gameplay. [b]Free Mode[/b] no longer aligns with the direction we’re taking, We want every part of the game to feel meaningful, intense, and directly tied to Angelica’s universe.

To make up for the cancellation, the long-anticipated [b]V.1.3.0 update[/b] has been brought forward to [b]April 11th, 2025[/b]. The update promises major story developments, new chaotic encounters, and key improvements that will shape the future of the game.

Players are encouraged to update their game on [b]April 11th[/b] to dive into the [b]First Bonus Level[/b] (which will be free to play) of Angelica’s Chaotic Hardcore School.

We sincerely apologize for this decision, but we believe it was the most appropriate course of action for the future of the game.

-The DyymaStudio Team

notes.title: ACHSR v.1.3.0 Arrives on May 11th
notes.notes:
Angelica’s Chaotic Hardcore School is receiving a major update with v.1.3.0, launching on May 11th. This update introduces:

New Bonus Level: "Computer Science" – The first bonus level, featuring tech-based challenges.
Fire Alarm System – The fire alarm will only activate if a call point is pressed, triggering a false alarm.
60 New Language Sentences – Expanded dialogue for more interactions.
Free Mode Season 1 – The first seasonal update for Free Mode, bringing new content to explore.

ACHSR continues to expand with new features and challenges. Stay tuned for more updates.
